shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "find app __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && printf '\\n--- app files ---\\n' && for file in app/*; do if [ -f \""'$file" ]; then echo "--- $file"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$file"; fi; done && printf '"'\\n--- eval files ---\\n' && for file in __agent_eval__/*; do if [ -f \""'$file" ]; then echo "--- $file"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$file"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/UserDashboard.tsx tsconfig.json && git status --short && nl -ba app/UserDashboard.tsx | sed -n '1,120p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/UserDashboard.tsx'
